name: Hotel Chais Monnet & Spa
positioning: Hotel set in the Chais Monnet, an 1838 cognac-cellar complex in the Charente region that is listed as a French industrial heritage site and was transformed by architect Didier Poignant
best_for: Travelers drawn to heritage architecture and the cognac region
Spa-focused stays with an indoor and outdoor pool

facts.text: The hotel is about 90 minutes from Bordeaux, in the heart of the Charente region.
The Chais Monnet site dates from 1838 and is listed as a French industrial heritage site.
Architect Didier Poignant transformed the former industrial site into the hotel.
A glass space links the four cellars and houses the hotel's main reception functions.
The rooms and suites are spread over four buildings and decorated in a classic French chic style.
The Jean Gabriel Monnet Suite has a grand reception room, a dining area and cooking facilities.
The pool has large floor-to-ceiling windows that let in natural light.
Spa body treatments use Kos Paris products based on rare plants grown in an environmentally friendly way.
The spa offers Nougatine treatments for children aged 3 to 12.
The rooftop of Bar 1838 overlooks the city of Cognac.
Several times a month, Bar 1838 hosts evening events exploring its partner cognac houses.

highlights.text: The site's historic features include the Grand Chai des Foudres, known as the Cathedral, with its remarkable framework.
The spa has an indoor and outdoor pool, a jacuzzi, saunas, steam rooms, experience showers and a fitness center.
The Jean Gabriel Monnet Suite has privileged access to a private treatment room for massages by the spa therapists.
The hotel's gardens are the work of landscape designer Louis Benech.
The cellars bear the name Monnet, a reference to Jean Monnet, who began his professional career there.

considerations.text: The pool will be closed from January 4 to 10, 2027 for annual maintenance.
The rooftop closes for the winter season, when Bar 1838 welcomes guests instead.
Elegant attire is required at the Les Foudres restaurant; casual or sportswear is not permitted.
